scope: One synthetic H.264 clip with AAC stereo on this 24-LP Ryzen/RTX machine. Fresh portable profiles, warm OS caches; no equal-output-quality or general player superiority claim. Actual CPU timestamps precede status/GPU queries. VLC positions are integer-quantized; outer windows match but viewports can differ. Root-process counters exclude shared system services. Memory accounts overlap and are not summed.
changes: Fixed a direct-launch bootstrap flag that continuously redrew an invisible overlay; defer the unused hub GPU device until hub/preview intent; reduce hardware decoder threads from four to one while preserving software threading. Corrected presentation-drop diagnostics to mpv frame-drop-count. H.2641080p30+audio and HEVC Main10 4K60+audio resource screens verified direct D3D11VA, no steady decoder/presentation drops, and equivalent fixed-frame captures (4K at most one pixel/channel level difference). All tests use this one GPU; this is not validation of every GPU, codec or workload. One synthetic H.264 clip with AAC stereo on this 24-LP Ryzen/RTX machine. Fresh portable profiles, warm OS caches; no equal-output-quality or general player superiority claim. Actual CPU timestamps precede status/GPU queries. VLC positions are integer-quantized; outer windows match but viewports can differ. Root-process counters exclude shared system services. Memory accounts overlap and are not summed.
discardedExperiments: D3D11 zero-copy, swapchain depth and latency screens did not establish an additional overall gain; not deployed.
Releasing free LFH caches saved only ~2.3MiB in one screen; not deployed.
failedEvidence: Initial hardware-thread screen failed because the diagnostic used unavailable vo-drop-frame-count; retained as a failed run. Subsequent screens require available decoder-frame-drop-count and frame-drop-count and reject steady drops.
limitations: Single-sample engine option screens identify candidates, not final player rankings.
59 functional checks cover behavior, not universal visual equivalence.
Intrusive stack traces are diagnostics; nearest exported libmpv symbols can be misleading. Uninstrumented comparison is kept separate.
goal: Aperture has improved, but a general performance win over VLC is not established.

visible-ms.note: 20ms launch observer and overlapping three-run ranges; visible shell is not video readiness. Do not attribute a ~14ms median difference to a causal startup regression.
